classification.difficultyReason: Transfers reciprocal values to a graph with whole-number people counts, and converts 30 minutes to hours before solving for the required number of people.

content.prompt: The time taken ($t$ in hours) to dig a hole is dependent on the number of people ($n$) digging the hole. This relationship is modelled using the formula $t=\frac{6}{n}$.

inlines.text: Complete the table of values and sketch the graph.

spec.description: First-quadrant labelled coordinate grid; the blank-grid template cannot express unequal axis scales and variable labels. House neutral-grey grid replaces decorative source blue.
spec.mathematics: Horizontal n: 0 to 6, grid step 0.5, labels 1–6. Vertical t: 0 to 10, grid step 1, labels 2,4,6,8,10.

spec.description: Complete solution graph with the six table values plotted as discrete points because people are counted in whole numbers.
